scope.evidence: All changed files serve the task: the notifier (`app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php`), logging/services config (`config/logging.php`, `config/services.php`), env/test pins (`.env.example`, `phpunit.xml`), docs (`docs/ops/logging.md`, `README.md:27`, `CHANGELOG.md:15,19`), and tests. issues.explanation: Redaction only inspects strings; `stringify()` casts any `Stringable` context value (for example an Eloquent model) after redaction, so a bearer credential or model attributes could still be sent to Discord. Redact the stringified value or render unknown objects with `get_debug_type()`.
The 'audit channel accepts writes' test only asserts `expect(true)->toBeTrue()`, so it passes even if the write is silently dropped; assert an actual log entry/spy or remove the test.

The tests assert env-derived values, but only `LOG_STACK` is pinned. The stack test runs with the pinned value, so it would not catch a revert of the `config/logging.php` default, and a local `.env` overriding `LOG_DAILY_DAYS`/`LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL`/`LOG_AUDIT_DAYS` can make the daily/audit tests fail. Set the config explicitly or pin those keys.
`array_map(fn ($v) => $v, $this->redactArray($value))` is an identity no-op; return `$this->redactArray($value)` directly.

review.summary: The change adds a config-driven DiscordOpsAlert with a 1800-character, redacted, soft-failing alert path, plus the daily/audit logging lanes, env/phpunit wiring, documentation, and Pest coverage. Requirements and conventions are met and the tests are broad, but I would merge after minor cleanup: close the Stringable/object redaction gap, make the audit-write test meaningful, and remove the redundant array_map.
